events.name: Hazard
events.description:
Findlay Docherty, now going by Hazard, is an international criminal member of the Phreaks, a radical anarchist movement of body-modding punks that seek to tear down the establishment in order to reform the world. Findlay grew poor under a family of Crisis veterans. His mother died when he was young and his father was absent, so for most of his life he grew up hoping that the surrounding institutions would provide any sort of lifeline if he played by the rules. This led him to eventually join the Scottish military as a way to pay for university, but in the early days of his career, a ship accident involving Overwatch and Talon left him a triple amputee. The government only provided basic prosthetics and medicine as well as a big check to keep quiet, and all Overwatch did was give their condolences to the victims, making Findlay lose any faith in the institutions meant to help him.

His search for better healthcare and cybernetics lead him to a local Phreaks cell, where he was augmented with illegal modifications. The more time he spent around the group, the more he sympathized for their cause, growing to see them as a family and even finding a lover among their ranks. Now fully committed to the Phreaks, he renounced his old life, took a new name and began participating in various protests, riots and heists across the world, aiding oppressed Omnics, stealing weaponry and destroying property, all in hopes of disrupting the establishment that failed him.

As the Phreaks grew, they came into conflict with Helix Security, causing many of their cells to be arrested prematurely by Oasis's predictive security systems. As retribution, Hazard's cell broke into Oasis's labs to steal the experimental Vanadium they used to supply Helix's weaponry. Hazard modified his body to be able to harness the Vanadium for himself, turning it into a living weapon that could turn the tide against the movement's suppressors, although the consequences of injecting the unstable Vanadium into his body are still uncertain.

events.name: Doomfist
events.description:
Akande Ogundimu is the Nigerian heir of Pinion International, one of the leading companies in the field of Cybernetics, previously known as Ogundimu Synergies, before rebranding to avoid association with Akande due to his crimes. Akande lost his arm during the crisis, and while his family was able to provide top-grade prosthetics, this gave him an unfair advantage that disqualified him from competing in martial arts, his true passion. Ever since he developed a radicalized world view that humanity must face conflict and overcome it in order to evolve.

Later in life, he enlisted to become a lieutenant to Akinjide Adeyemi, a warmonger who stole the Doomfist Gauntlet from the Crisis war hero Adhabu Ngumi. Under his wing, Akande learned of Talon, an international criminal syndicate, shackled under Adeyemi's command of mindless violence and petty thievery. Appalled by his mentor's lack of ambision, he sought his chance to murder him, taking control of the Gauntlet and Talon, using them to spread chaos around the world and pursue his twisted ideology. Doomfist's Reign in Talon has been turbulent, as his volatile attacks around the world caught the attention of Overwatch, leading to his arrest and imprisonment in Watchpoint: Grímsvötn. Still, he commanded Talon from his cell until his eventual breakout years after Overwatch's shut down. 

His return was marked by continued attacks on the city of Numbani and a heavy role in enabling Null Sector's global invasion, but it came into a halt when The Wolf of Retribution, Vendetta, infiltrated Talon and defeated Akande in combat, taking over the organization and reshaping it to her image. Doomfist, however, survived the attack, seeing it as a chance to evolve past his own shortcomings. With the help of his loyalists, they managed to claim Grímsvötn as their new base of operations, built a new Gauntlet and put a stop to Vendetta. In spite of his comeback, Talon remains unstable, and with Vendetta still alive, he awaits the day she returns to challenge him once more.

events.name: Winston
events.description:
Specimen 28, going by Winston, is one of the many Apes taken to Horizon Lunar Colony by Lucheng Interstellar, as a means to experiment and observe the effects of long-term life in Space. Lucheng modified their specimens for years through genetic therapy, allowing them to become larger, stronger and smarter. Winston in particular was an outstanding specimen, taken under the wing of Doctor Harold Winston for further study, alongside another oddity, Specimen 8, Hammond the Hamster. Winston saw the Doctor as a father figure, and through him, he learned of science and history, longing to one day see Earth for himself. His wish was granted when the rest of the Apes in the colony rebelled and killed all the scientists, forcing Winston to leave everything behind in an escape pod.

On Earth, Winston was taken under the care of Overwatch, a peacekeeping organization that helped him obtain legal personhood and recruited him under their scientific staff and later on as part of the Strike team. Among his biggest accomplishments, he was able to create a chronological accelerator to keep Tracer, a pilot lost to time, anchored in the present, and he played a key role in defeating and imprisoning Doomfist, the head of the terrorist group, Talon. But when Overwatch was shut down, Winston retreated to the depths of Watchpoint: Gibraltar, accompanied only by Overwatch's assistant AI, Athena, as he watched the world set ablze by conflict, itching to do something to help, but legally forbidden from intervening.

When Talon attacked him directly in Gibraltar while trying to obtain the agent database, Winston decided it was finally time to recall all agents and restart operations, regardless of the law. At the time, only Tracer answered the call, but as conflict reigned across the world, more agents began to realize Overwatch was still needed, culminating in the formal reforming of Overwatch at the start of the Null Sector Invasion. Since then, Winston has championed Overwatch's new-found purpose through the Invasion and the new Talon Empire, in spite of the IJC's objections and continued suppression. But between the arrival of Juno, the first martial and another victim of Lucheng, and his reunion with Hammond, who was now on a crusade to destroy the company, it seems the ghosts Winston left behind on the moon are finally catching up to haunt him again.

events.name: Wrecking Ball
events.description:
The Champion of Junkertown's Scrapyard, Wrecking Ball, is in reality Hammond, formally known as specimen 8, a hamster from Horizon Lunar Colony. The Scienstist at Lucheng Interstellar modified his genetics in an attempt to push the boundaries of humanity and lead the course of life beyond Earth, but in their hubris they left Hammond lonely, suffering from experiments and without being able to communicate with his unevolved family. While he was at least able to bond with Specimen 28, a young gorilla who named himself Winston, that friendship came to an end when the rest of the Apes rose against the scientists, killing everyone in the colony. 

Winston had taken Hammond's secret escape pod that he meant to use for both of them, and in haste, Hammond designed a smaller pod that he could attach to Winston's so they could at least escape together. The grapple that hooked both pods broke while entering the atmosphere, and while Winston landed safely at the hands of Overwatch, Hammond ended in the irradiated Australian Outback, where he found his way to Junkertown, building a mech from scrap to conceal his identity and participate in the scrapyard battles, rising up to become the champion and the Queen's closest confidant. While he was comfortable amongst the Junkers, he left the city on occasion to explore the world, or to collect prices for the Queen. During the Null Sector Invasion, he infiltrated Lijiang Power to collect ship parts for the Queen, where he reunited with Doctor Chao, the head of Lucheng, and the scientist in charge of the experiments they did on him. 

While he spared her life, he sought to take down the company, and with the Junker mothership repaired, they are now able to wreck havoc on not just Lucheng, but the rest of the world. Their first target, however, was Busan, returning the favor to Talon since they provided the missing parts for the ship. Wrecking Ball was captured by MEKA during the Busan attack, and when they called in Overwatch to open up his mech, Hammond was able to reconcile with Winston, realizing he didn't mean to leave him behind, but instead he ran out of time to wait for him. Hammond escaped MEKA and Overwatch, returning to the Junkers, preparing for their next attack, but now knowing he is not alone, his old friend was overjoyed to see him still alive.

events.name: D.va
events.description:
Hana Song, most commonly known by her gamer tag "D.va" is a professional esports player from South Korea, quickly rising to fame alongside her senior team member, Yuna Lee, also known as "D.mon". Together they became world champions in Mecha Guardian V. During most of her life, South Korea faced the thread of the Gwishin, giant war machines emerging from the East China Sea after the Crisis, evolving every time they were defeated. In response to this thread, the military formed the Mobile Exo-Force of the Korean Army, an experimental program that designed weaponry, drones and eventually mechs capable of battling the Gwishin. Over time, they realized the few pilots who survived had one thing in common; they were profesisonal gamers, and the skills they learned for playing translated well when piloting real mechs. As a response, the government drafted several top professional players to become the next generation of pilots, including both D.va and D.mon.


Hana's inhuman reflexes and APM made her an ace pilot, quickly becoming the face of the team, a key player in stopping several attacks, even stopping some entirely by herself. The fame of her gaming career and military prowess resulted in several sponsorships and movie deals, but her number one priority was always defending Korea, as her highly competitive nature and the weight of a country on her shoulders led her to develop a lot of self-destructive tendencies, heavily injuring herself by pulling extremely risky strategies in order to stop the Gwishin no matter the cost. During the Null Sector Invasion, Hana believed MEKA's experience fighting the Gwishin could help fend off the warbots across the world, so when Overwatch came to help repel Null Sector, her commander, Minh, decided to endorse an ongoing partnership, allowing Hana to operate alongside Overwatch with the goal of collecting intel and combat data for Korea's benefit. 

Since then, she's remained alongside Overwatch under IJC jurisdiction, becoming a key player in combating both Null Sector and Talon alongside the new generation of recruits. She returned to Busan when the Junker Armada attacked the MEKA base, in a joint operation by Talon to steal the experimental EMP Bomb that MEKA developed as a fail-safe against the Gwishin. But outside of specific emergency circumstances, she remains a highly valued agent for the newly reformed Overwatch following the renewal of their charter, especially after Overwatch and MEKA collaborated to secure the EMP Bomb from Talon's grasp, cementing their ongoing alliance even further.

events.name: Mauga
events.description:
Maugaloa Malos is a Samoan warrior once part of the Deep Sea Raiders, a Polynesian alliance of eco-terrorists that boarded oil carriers in the Pacific Ocean, hijacking them and crashing them into the Super Coral barrier reef, a modified super organism made to restore the Ocean ecosystems and seen as part of Polynesian patrimony, but one that had become quite troublesome for ship traffic, with many companies advocating for its destruction. The battles over the Super Coral reef led to Over watch's interference, where the Raiders were able to hold their ground, leading to the Polynesian League  seceding from the United Nations, and effectively giving up on stopping the Raiders' activities.

Their success did not come without a cost, as Mauga was heavily injured during their battles, forcing their medics to implant a cybernetic heart, and then a second one later in life when his organic one began to fail all together. Living with two ticking time bombs in his chest and coming so close to dying reshaped Mauga's outlook on life, to a more careless, apathetic view that he lived every day like it was his last, since his heart could very well fail at any given moment. When the Raiders died down, he challenged the Doomfist, the head of the terrorist group Talon, to an all-out battle that ended in a tie. Doomfist offered him a place in Talon, where he was able to wreak havoc around the world and gain maintenance for his heart.

In Talon, Mauga made few friends, as his brutish facade and lost cannon mentality caused friction among his peers. The only one who he truly grew close to was Baptiste, a mercenary who used to operate for the Caribbean Coalition. But Baptiste eventually defected Talon, with Mauga eventually leading the hunt to chase him down after everyone else who was sent after him didn't return. Mauga's alliance with Talon is entirely derived from the entertainment he gets from being a part of it, as when Vendetta took over Doomfist's title as leader, he decided to stay and became one of her most efficient and active generals. When Doomfist reclaimed his title from the Wolf of Retribution, however, Mauga remained in Talon, caring little for who was in charge, as he rejoiced in the chaos left from the ever-changing leadership.

events.name: Orisa
events.description:
Orisa is the magnum opus of child prodigee Efi Oladele, a young engineer from the city of Numbani. Efi grew up surrounded by the latest in robotics and quickly earned a name for herself after winning the city's Genius Grant for her personal Junior Assistant Drones that she sold for her community. However, when the warmongering Terrorist Doomfist broke out of Prison and reclaimed his Gauntlet as it was being transported to Numbani's Museum, he began spreading chaos in Numbani and pitting Omnics and humans against each other. Efi knew she needed to do something to stop him, so she decided to use her grant money to create a proper hero for Numbani.

Buying the wrecked parts of the Idina OR15 defense robots that Doomfist destroyed when he reclaimed his gauntlet, Efi began to work on designing a highly advanced AI that could protect the city from Doomfist, naming her Orisa after the deities of the Yoruba faith. But while she was advanced, Orisa was also inexperienced and struggled to truly understand what it meant to be a hero, putting Efi in a lot of trouble with the city over many accidents. Eventually, however, the duo were able to chase Doomfist out of Numbani during a charity concert by Brasilian activist and DJ, Lúcio. Their success even caught the attention of Efi's childhood hero, Vivian Chase, formerly known as agent Sojourn from Overwatch.

Inspired by Sojourn's teachings, Efi continued to upgrade Orisa to make her a fiercer fighter, as well as updating the Junie drones to be able to defend the city on their own, which proved critical during the Null Sector Invasion. With Overwatch reformed and the world in chaos, Orisa and Efi came in contact with Sojourn once more, joining the group in their efforts to save the world from Null Sector and later on Talon. While Orisa assisted agents on the battlefield and aided civilians, Efi became a key player in the background, deciphering the enemy's code and bypassing their defenses, allowing Overwatch to retake Watchpoint: Gibraltar after Talon's all out attack forced them to evacuate it. But Efi and Orisa still have a lot to learn about what it means to be a hero, especially after Sojourn decided to let Doomfist go to protect their outnumbered team, something that hurts both of the young heroes given how much damage Doomfist and Talon had caused to their city and their family.

events.name: Roadhog
events.description:
Mako Rutledge is an Australian war veteran of the Omnic Crisis, who joined many other residents of the Outback in protest when the government decided to lend the land surrounding the Omnium factory to the newly awakened Omnics, a move that was heavily controversial given how much it displaced people affected by the war, to reward the machines they once considered enemies, and who many did not even see as alive. When the government failed to hear their voices, many of these protestors radicalized and formed the Australian Liberation Front, a rouge militia that broke into the Omnium and triggered a nuclear explosion that irradiated the entire Outback.

From the fall out of the Omnium, rose the survivors to claim it as their own nation, calling it Junkertown. The apocalyptic landscape of the Australian wasteland was not kind to the Junkers, between the mutated fauna, radiation poisoning and the constant attacks from raiders and feral Omnics. This harsh environment forced many into madness and ruthless violence to survive. Mako, now going by Roadhog, had at first cooperated within Junker society, joining the Wreckers and helping to build the city, but overtime he grew to hate the life they had, while seeing it as an earned punishment. He made sure to keep everyone around him as miserable as possible, leaving the Wreckers and setting up shop in front of the city borders as an act of defiance to the Queen.

His greatest crime was to partner with Jamison Fawkes, known as Junkrat, a troublemaker who hired him as a bodyguard after he angered the Queen by keeping his treasure secret from her. For their repeated offenses, they were both exiled, and began a years-long international crime spree as a way to amass a large amount of riches they could use to buy their way back into the city and enact their revenge. While their plotting failed, the Queen spared them from execution when Junkrat finally revealed his treasure, allowing them both back into the city and even bringing them along to attack Busan once the treasure, a Crisis-era mothership, was fully repaired and ready to fly. Now that they are back in Junkertown and got a ship, Mako awaits the next chance to take a tour around the world, ravaging anything that comes his way, spreading misery around the world.

events.name: Zarya
events.description:
Aleksandra Zaryanova is a Russian weightlifter, globally known as the strongest woman alive. Born in  the small Siberian village of Novoanskoye, Zarya lost her parents during the Omnic crisis. Being left to take care of her sisters, she began working out to get stronger to protect them and help rebuild their community. As she grew older, she pursued body building professionally and was given a chance to compete representing Russia, breaking Olympic records in her category and becoming an international icon. But when the Siberian Omnium suddenly reawakened and war machines began attacking innocent civilians in Russia, she decided to withdraw from competing and enlisted in the army to defend her country, quickly rising to the rank of Sergeant and being given an experimental particle cannon by Volskaya Industries, a heavy weapon meant to be operated by giant mechs. 

But while her passion to defend Russia from heartless machines was unbreakable, it appeared that the RDF confused that determination for blind loyalty when Katya Volskaya requested her to personally track down a hacker that infiltrated her office and blackmailed her personally. Zarya's endless search for the Hacker opened her mind to the suffering of Omnics beyond the mindless drones she fought in Siberia, and most importantly, when she confronted the hacker, Sombra, she revealed to her that Volskaya was getting technology from the Omnics behind the reawaken Omnium, the very thing that was causing thousands of deaths. Zarya returned to the battlefield, but with her commitment to her country shaken, and without any wish to engage with Katya's business.

When the Omncis eventually ravaged Novoanskoye, the army rethreaded, leaving any survivors to die. Zarya, however, stayed behind, rescuing her family and other civilians with the help of Cole Cassidy, who came to recruit her to Overwatch. Choosing to save lives around the world instead of fighting for a country that betrayed her twice, she joined the cowboy and regrouped with the reformed Overwatch, fighting at their side during the Null Sector Invasion and Vendetta's short-lived Reign of Talon, becoming a highly valued agent and a great motivation for many of the younger recruits who aspired to be like her. While the IJC has a watchful eye on Overwatch's activities, Zarya knows better than anyone that standing up for what is right often means going against your superiors, choosing to save lives over being a pawn for those in control of the world.
